text:
maria: Heads up, vendor portal (ResellerCo) just rejected PO#7894321 — says vendor alias missing taxID. Procurement says they won't accept without a signed MSA redline. Pls advise. @jason @liam :eyes:
liam: ack, looping legal. did procurement provide the rejection screenshot?
jason: can you paste the portal error or screenshot? if it's taxID we can push a temporary invoice waiver until MSA sorted, but need C-level approval (procurement).
maria: screenshot pasted in the ticket — portal message: "Missing Tax ID for billing entity". procurement says they need PO on file to finish onboarding reseller.
jason: i'll prep a minimal redline that only covers the merchant alias/tax clause. can legal and partnerships agree on the wording quick?
olivia: reseller says they can sign an expedited redline today if we send it. need to confirm who sends and who updates the marketplace merchant alias after.
marketplace-bot: Queue updated: PO 7894321 status -> flagged_for_manual_review by Partnerships.
liam: ok i'll coordinate sending redline + ask procurement for an interim acceptance email. maria — can you confirm the billing entity EIN format so legal puts exact data in the redline?
maria: EIN sent via DM. i'll also attach the signed PO once reseller signs.
jason: once signed i'll countersign and ping ops to re-run the PO sync. estimated turnaround 24–48h if reseller signs today.
olivia: reseller confirmed signing ETA ~3h.
maria: great — i'll update the partner ticket and close the loop once ops confirms sync. thanks all :thumbsup:
